description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to lookup functionality in a web application, including popup handling, error reporting, collapsing UI panels, and AJAX communication for lookups.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: A class that manages popup lookup dialogs, including AJAX requests, dialog positioning, and event handling.

classes.name: FieldLookupCounter
classes.description: A counter class to manage unique lookup instance identifiers.

classes.name: ButtonModifier
classes.description: A utility class to modify link behaviors inside lookup dialogs for proper AJAX handling and UI enhancements.

classes.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded
classes.description: A helper class to load and update lookup field descriptions asynchronously.

methods.name: getViewNameWithSeparator
methods.description: Determines the correct separator ('?' or '&') for URL query parameters based on existing view name.

methods.name: lookup_error
methods.description: Displays an error alert message related to lookup errors.

methods.name: lookup_popup1
methods.description: Opens a lookup popup window with specified size and URL parameters.

methods.name: lookup_popup2
methods.description: Opens a different style of lookup popup window, appending parameters.

methods.name: fieldLookup1
methods.description: Constructs a lookup object with methods to trigger popup windows for lookup selection.

methods.name: fieldLookup2
methods.description: Constructs a lookup object with support for two target controls.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup3
methods.description: Creates a lookup instance and triggers popup for a specific view.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup
methods.description: Creates a lookup instance and opens a popup window with default dimensions.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup2
methods.description: Creates a lookup instance and opens a popup window with specified view.

methods.name: CollapsePanel
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a UI panel, collapsing or expanding it.

methods.name: initiallyCollapse
methods.description: Collapse panels on page load if configured to do so.

methods.name: initiallyCollapseDelayed
methods.description: Schedules initial collapse after delay.

methods.name: lookupAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to load lookup data content.

methods.name: lookupFormAjaxRequest
methods.description: Submits a lookup form via AJAX and updates the dialog content.

methods.name: lookupPaginationAjaxRequest
methods.description: Handles pagination in lookup result sets via AJAX.

methods.name: setSourceColor
methods.description: Highlights an element to indicate update.

methods.name: set_duration_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window and closes lookup.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a single value in the target control.

methods.name: set_values
methods.description: Sets multiple values in target controls.

methods.name: write_value
methods.description: Writes a value into a target input control.

methods.name: set_multivalues
methods.description: Sets multiple values into a target and triggers UI updates.

methods.name: closeLookup
methods.description: Closes the lookup dialog or window.

methods.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes lookup description loader with field and URL parameters.

methods.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded.prototype.update
methods.description: Fetches and updates description information asynchronously.
